sentences.show: On this day in 1983, a Soviet officer may have saved the world, by doing nothing.
Stanislav Petrov was on duty near Moscow, at the height of the Cold War.
Just after midnight, the alarm went off.
An American missile was on its way. Then four more.
Protocol said report it, and the answer would be a nuclear strike.
But Petrov reasoned that a real attack would use hundreds of missiles, not five.
So he called it a false alarm, and waited.
The satellites had mistaken sunlight on clouds for rocket launches.
Petrov got no reward. For ten years, even his wife didn't know.
When she asked, he said: I did nothing.
Every day has a story like this.
